about_the_game:
In TakeDogs, you'll experience war firsthand. You'll join different Special Forces and Armed Forces from around the world. Set in modern conflicts and real-life scenarios, the game is scaled 1:1 using geospatial data. Our vision is to offer the most authentic military simulation possible involving infantry, military aircraft, ground vehicles, and armored vehicles.

▶ GAMEMODES

- Special Operations:

This is the CQB (Close Quarters Battle) game mode for 5v5 player battles. It features two modes: "Casual" and "Ranked" based on attack and defense.

- Battlefield:

This is the authentic war game mode for global region battles with over 1,000 players per game. It features three modes: "Combined Operations" "Air Battles" and "Ground Battles"

- Terrorist Hunt: 

This is the game mode where you'll train and learn real-world tactics to learn how to fight in both closed and open spaces. It features two modes "Co-op" and "Lone Wolf"

▶ REALISTIC GAMEPLAY

TakeDogs recreates the physics and realistic behavior of projectiles as they impact and penetrate surfaces, taking into account caliber, weapon, distance, and other key factors.

The characters are designed with realistic human anatomy, providing an unprecedented level of detail and authenticity. Each shot or impact has precise effects on the body, reflecting realistic reactions. The damage and gore system will be improved with future updates, offering more detailed and intense graphical effects for an even more realistic and visceral war simulation.

▶ MILITARY VEHICLES

TakeDogs offers modern military vehicles with realistic physics and authentic behavior. From tanks to helicopters and fighter jets, each simulates weight, inertia, and real-life systems. Ignition, armament, and controls require training, especially in aircraft, which replicate realistic flight procedures and dynamics. More than just transportation, vehicles are key elements in battlefield strategy.

content_descriptors.notes: The game shows very violent images as it represents the horror of real war.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i or AMD Ryzen with 4 physical cores
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or at least 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i or AMD Ryzen with 6 physical cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or at least 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A microphone

short_description: TakeDogs is a realistic modern warfare FPS where you will join a special operations group, fight on real maps at 1:1 scale simulating authentic ballistic physics, learn to pilot real aircraft and travel to conflict zones to dismantle terrorist organizations or high-value targets.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
